title: Ten Ten Forever
equation: Relationship Wealth = Trust × Time × Mutual Value
hook: Ten people you really invest in will do more for you than a thousand business cards.
statement: Wealth is often about who, not how. Invest deeply in a small group of people over a long time.
explainer: This isn't transactional networking. It's showing up for the same people for years. Do that, and referrals, honest advice, and opportunities start arriving without you asking.
sop: Give value before you ask for anything.
Stay in touch over years, not months.
Score Trust, Time, and Mutual Value from 1 to 10 each year.
equation_example: Trust 8, Time 6, Mutual Value 7. 8 × 6 × 7 = 336 Relationship Wealth, out of 1,000. Higher means the relationship compounds and good things show up unasked. Lower means it's still transactional and fades once the asking stops.
question: Write down the 10 people you want to invest in for the next 10 years.
closing_statement: Invest in people before you need them.
caption:
Principle Nº 265: Ten Ten Forever

Ten people you really invest in will do more for you than a thousand business cards.

Wealth is often about who, not how. Invest deeply in a small group of people over a long time.
